# connectors_grafana v1

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/grafana/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/grafana/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

## The system as a graph

```mermaid
flowchart TB
```

A command is accepted by the component that owns its context, emits the events one of its outcomes declares, and a dashed edge is a binding carrying an event into the next command. Design §9 begins one step earlier, at the actor who invokes the first command, and so does this graph: a solid edge out of an actor is a grant, and an actor drawn with no edge at all may invoke nothing — which is something the model says, not an arrow somebody forgot.

## Bounded contexts

- **[connection](./domains/connectors_grafana-connection.md)** (`connectors_grafana.connection`) — The Grafana local connection — its native configuration, the `grafana.service_account` and `grafana.irm_service_account` profiles and the configured identity probes that prove a service-account token. Nine types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[discovery](./domains/connectors_grafana-discovery.md)** (`connectors_grafana.discovery`) — Grafana-owned discovery profile and collection partition identifier. Three types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[irm](./domains/connectors_grafana-irm.md)** (`connectors_grafana.irm`) — Grafana Cloud IRM alert groups, incidents and the alert groups an incident references, read over a since window the caller advances; read only. 12 types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[records](./domains/connectors_grafana-records.md)** (`connectors_grafana.records`) — The bounded data-source records `datasources.list` returns, read from Grafana's `GET /api/datasources`. Four types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.

## Components

A component is a unit of ownership, not a deployment. How many of each runs, and what each needs, is [the topology](./topology.md).
